about.en: Cysic is a compute network that combines hardware acceleration for zero-knowledge proofs with tokenized, verifiable compute markets, which it calls ComputeFi. CYS, with a 1,000,000,000 supply, is the network token, deployed on BNB Chain at 0x0C69199C1562233640e0Db5Ce2c399A88eB507C7 and on Base.
